runtimeObservation.source: One owner-operated 2026-10-12 System Link capture between two Xenia Canary Netplay instances, emulator SHA-256 5EBC1583E1DB5EE50FDA028461CAAF03CEE79D91B62FD0B1A3C9A08E1C67E8F9 (netplay_canary_experimental@b5f6f6ed6), running base default.xex SHA-256 B59B8957A3ED9DD90E9296C96D5C7AB1B16078D3F08B015582714A06C7D6A7BD with no title update, on two interfaces of one PC. Only structural facts were retained.
runtimeObservation.discovery: Every discovery datagram was addressed to 255.255.255.255. The client sent one 16-byte FE FD 02 echo to each port 26900 through 27000 (101 datagrams); host QR2 port 26900 answered with an 86-byte type 0x05 echo response, then the client sent a 23-byte FE FD 09 prequery and a 27-byte FE FD 00 query from a second OS-assigned port, answered with 15-byte and 201-byte replies. Each reply carries request bytes 3-6 at bytes 1-4.
runtimeObservation.differencesFromPin: Against UniSpySDK bbac5ff, the echo request is 16 bytes rather than 8, the echo response is 86 bytes, and replies and follow-up queries go to the limited broadcast address rather than to the sender.
runtimeObservation.join: Each instance opened one VDP (protocol 0xFE) socket on guest port 1000. Its datagrams carried a 2-byte big-endian length prefix, then GT2 magic FE FE; the handshake ran ClientChallenge, ServerChallenge, ClientResponse, Accept in 92 ms, and all play traffic used AppReliable and Ack on that port only.
runtimeObservation.negatives: Neither the capture nor either emulator log showed UDP to ports 53, 27900, or 27901, an XNetDnsLookup call, or XSessionSearch. That run sent no QR2 master heartbeat.
runtimeObservation.unboundSockets: The client's discovery sockets were never bound, so the host operating system chose the broadcast route; a lower-metric virtual adapter captured the first four sweeps until it was disabled.
runtimeObservation.qualification: This corroborates the mode-1 LAN query, QR2 host port, and GT2 join of the static result. It ran the base title version, not the pinned version 1.3 image, under Netplay's XNet emulation, whose broadcast and VDP handling is emulator behavior rather than console proof. It does not identify the runtime ispublic source or the UI owner of 0x82D6C398, and ReRevved was not run.

conclusion: Version 1.3 embeds GameSpy QR2, Server Browsing, GT2, and an unreached availability check, and carries no NAT Negotiation, GP, GameStats, SAKE, Peer/Chat, CD-key, or MOTD host. Its gamename is the PlayStation 3 identifier civconps3, and a six-byte secret key is built from immediates in 0x82D8CC28. Session mode 1 installs table 0x82160348: browsing creates a LAN-only QR2 Server Browser and broadcasts a 16-byte QR2 echo to UDP ports 26900 through 27000, and hosting calls qr2_initA with base port 26900, binding the first free port up to 26999. Other modes install table 0x82160450, which searches through XGI messages 0x000B0016 and 0x000B001B and makes no GameSpy call. No title path reaches the GameSpy master list in the recorded tested forms. nativeQr2ArgumentBoundary corrects the record pointer/length and zero flag inputs, and conditionally excludes the selected master-resolution suffix. Whole QR2 lifetime and runtime traffic remain separate. One emulator capture of the base title corroborated the mode-1 exchange, QR2 port 26900, a GT2 join on guest port 1000, and no master traffic. The visible Refresh action and actual current QR2/session state remain unjoined.

nativeQr2ArgumentBoundary.question: Which native QR2 arguments are the session-record pointer, length and two initialization flags, and does the selected host call admit master-address resolution?
nativeQr2ArgumentBoundary.classification: Proved statically: the earlier assignment of ispublic to r8 and natnegotiate to r9 is incorrect for this Xbox native call. Under the selected retained service/wrapper classes, r8 is Q+0C and r9 is 60. The caller independently supplies r10=0 and its first stack argument=0. The native forwarding and initializer distinguish these fields. Under retained frame inputs and compatible normal helper returns, the zero r10 branch skips the selected master-address formatting/resolution suffix. Runtime packet absence, whole QR2 lifetime and discovery success are not established.
nativeQr2ArgumentBoundary.scope: Eight selected owners: five complete PE extents and three bounded two-instruction leaves without PE entries. The accepted S+2C getter is revalidated rather than a new semantic expansion. Seven other owners are newly examined for this question. S is the registry-resolved primary service, Q1/Q2 are separately sampled nested wrappers, H the host session, C the initializer context and F a current initializer frame. Require valid separate mapped objects, frames, strings and extents, compatible normally returning helpers, original thunk/full-register ABI, retained actual classes/keys/outputs and no destructive aliases/interference. Separate getter/global samples do not prove equal current generations. No UI event, generic registry descendant or later QR2 heartbeat body is expanded.
nativeQr2ArgumentBoundary.hostAndRegistry: C9F320 first requires a nonempty retained name and nonnull CAAAA8(global 8314F204,H+0C) result S. Reuse registryAndService for conditional key lookup and CB12F0 final service table 8215FA78. At C9F3D8 it requests S+18C and retains that result, then freshly samples S vptr for +188 at C9F3F0. It places the latter full result in r8 and the former in r9 before A09988 at C9F438. The two method calls and current tables require their own retention conditions. The host method does not itself inspect either result as a Boolean.
nativeQr2ArgumentBoundary.selectedSlots: For actual retained table 8215FA78, cells 8215FC00/8215FC04 bind +188 to CA3AE0 and +18C to CA3A60. Both methods request service+10C twice when the first result is nonnull. With selected cell 8215FB84=822E2750, each getter returns U32[S+2C]. A null first sample returns explicit 0. A nonnull first sample gates a fresh second sample, which is dereferenced without another local null check. CA3AE0 invokes that second wrapper+5C; CA3A60 invokes its +60. Q1 and Q2 are not equated by this pattern.
nativeQr2ArgumentBoundary.recordAndLength: For a retained actual second wrapper table 82160630, selected cell 8216068C (+5C) contains C992B0, which returns Q+0C; selected cell 82160690 (+60) contains C992A8, which returns explicit 60. The pointer and size are separate results from separate wrapper samples. Reuse accepted wrapperConstruction for the conditional service+2C factory/table link and wrapperAndGetter for the getter. The existing invite/session records supply the XSESSION_INFO interpretation. This packet proves pointer/length shape; it does not prove that the 60 bytes are populated, coherent, current, delivered or safe to reuse later.
nativeQr2ArgumentBoundary.callerFlags: Independently of those two virtual results, C9F3F4 sets r5=0 and C9F400 writes 0 at caller SP+54. C9F430 sets r10=0. At C9F438 these are argument 8 and argument 9 when counting the incoming r3 as argument 1. They are distinct from argument 6=r8 and argument 7=r9. Six selected callback words and userdata follow on the stack. Public/native layout must not borrow the 14-argument external layout by position.
nativeQr2ArgumentBoundary.forwarding: A09988 uses a frame 0xA0. It stores incoming r8/r9/r10 at its frame+DC/+E4/+EC and, after admitted socket creation, reloads them at A09A28/A09A24/A09A20 for A09368 at A09A40. The original caller SP+54 is copied through current frame+F4 to outgoing SP+54 at A09A18/A09A1C. Error before this call returns the socket helper result. The two extra pointer/length arguments precede the two flag inputs in this Xbox native ABI.
nativeQr2ArgumentBoundary.copyAndStoredFlags: A09368 uses frame 0xC0. It stores incoming r8/r9/r10 at F+FC/+104/+10C. It writes the saved r10 to C+1C8 at A094B0 and the incoming first stack word F+114 to C+1D4 at A094C8. At A095FC..A09644, nonnull saved r8 and nonzero saved r9 admit a bounded-length copy request into C+90, with reported length written at C+190. A positive supplied 60 is below the signed cap 256 and therefore requests 60 bytes. Helper success and source/destination retention are separate premises; no completed copy is inferred merely from the call.
nativeQr2ArgumentBoundary.masterResolutionGuard: After A0A190 returns, A0964C reloads saved r10 and A09654 branches to A09734 when it is0. This skips the selected A09658..A09730 suffix, including the conditional master-address formatting at A09688 and resolver request A0A278(port 27900) at A096C4. A09734 stages 1 for the final local result and its normal path returns 0. This proves the selected guarded call exclusion under retained arguments, not no network traffic anywhere, successful socket binding, no later context mutation or all-caller QR2 behavior. The ispublic and natnegotiate names are structural interpretations from the earlier external GameSpy comparison; the Xbox word flow and branch prove the argument distinction without using PS3 names as authority.
nativeQr2ArgumentBoundary.minimalProposal: Correct the evidence and diagnostic labels. No title or SDK behavior change is selected. Preserve the deliberate zero values, pointer/length shape, current-object checks and native result distinctions.
